artifacts.summary: Exhaustive audit of architecture.md's source tree vs. real FormalSystem/ layout, a verified ground-truth count (20) for the Conservativity aggregator's re-exports with a recommendation, and a resolution for the MinusLanguage/Soundness.lean row-placement question.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, docs/user-guide/architecture.md's source-tree diagram and docs/project-info/implementation-status.md's module table both use a mixed 'representative + directory pointer' style, not exhaustive file enumeration -- some directories (Syntax/, ProofSystem/, MinusLanguage/, Semantics/ top-level, Metalogic/ top-level) list every direct file while their own subdirectories (e.g. Metalogic/Core/, Bundle/) are shown as bare pointers. When auditing these docs for drift, check both files-present-but-undocumented AND wrong-parent placement (e.g. a real repo-root directory drawn as nested under FormalSystem/), not just nonexistent-file citations.

BimodalLogic's scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory only regenerates <!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory dir=... --> blocks inside FormalSystem/**/README.md (and similar per-directory README files); it does not touch docs/user-guide/architecture.md or docs/project-info/implementation-status.md, which carry no such markers. Editing those two files' prose does not trigger or interact with the INV gate.

BimodalLogic's lake-build-guard.sh lives at .claude/scripts/lake-build-guard.sh, not scripts/lake-build-guard.sh -- unlike check-module-invariants.sh and readme-lint.sh, which genuinely are at top-level scripts/. A dispatch or doc that writes the bare scripts/ path for the build guard is wrong; verify with find before trusting it.
